definitions.text: An unidentified substance mentioned in the Bible (Gen. ii. 12, and Num. xi. 7), variously taken to be a gum, a precious stone, or pearls, or perhaps a kind of amber found in Arabia.
A gum resin of reddish brown color, brought from India, Persia, and Africa. Balsamodendron Roxb. Other kinds are known as African, Sicilian, etc.
The order of Annulata which includes the leeches. See Hirudinea.
A cupping glass to which are attached a scarificator and an exhausting syringe. Dunglison.
An order of Nemertina, including the large leechlike worms (Malacobdella) often parasitic in clams.
